```{r}
# integration with the scRNA-seq reference.

##############################################################################################
# with reference
allen_reference <- readRDS(file = paste0(Scindir, "Pyelonephritis_singlecell_v012626.RDS"))

# final annotation 
allen_reference@meta.data %>% head()
levels(as.factor(allen_reference@meta.data$FinalAnnotation))

# change the order the cell types
Idents(allen_reference) <- "FinalAnnotation"
length(levels(Idents(allen_reference)))
# set up the order 
CelltypeOrder <- c("PT-S1S2","PT-S3","DCT-TAL", "TAL", "CNT","DTL","PC","ICA" ,"ICB", "DegCD",  "URO",  "END","FIB" ,"PL","NEU", "MAC", "T" ,"B","NK" )

Idents(allen_reference)<- ordered(factor(Idents(allen_reference)),levels=CelltypeOrder)


# save into h5seurat
SaveH5Seurat(allen_reference, filename = "PIPSeq_Final_UsedForScanpy.h5Seurat")

getwd()
# transfer into h5ad
Convert("PIPSeq_Final_UsedForScanpy.h5Seurat", dest = "h5ad")


```

# Deconvolution with RCTD
```{r}
# take a look at the data
head(allen_reference@meta.data)
DimPlot(object = allen_reference,
        group.by = "FinalAnnotation")

# spacexr doesn't like labels with "/" in it, so let's change that
allen_reference$Celltype <-
  gsub(pattern = "/", 
       replacement = "-", 
       x = allen_reference$FinalAnnotation)
GetAssayData(object = allen_reference, layer = "counts")
# create the spacexr reference object
spacexr_reference <-
  spacexr::Reference(
    counts = GetAssayData(object = allen_reference,
                          layer = "counts"),
    cell_types = as.factor(allen_reference$Celltype),
     n_max_cells = 30000
  )
?spacexr::Reference
# get x and y coordinates for our visium data

GetTissueCoordinates(object = Pyelonephritis_Infection, 
                             image = "slice9") %>% head()
coords <- 
  rbind(GetTissueCoordinates(object = Pyelonephritis_Infection, 
                             image = "slice1"),
        GetTissueCoordinates(object = Pyelonephritis_Infection, 
                             image = "slice3"),
        GetTissueCoordinates(object = Pyelonephritis_Infection, 
                             image = "slice4"),
        GetTissueCoordinates(object = Pyelonephritis_Infection, 
                             image = "slice7"),
        GetTissueCoordinates(object = Pyelonephritis_Infection, 
                             image = "slice8"),
        GetTissueCoordinates(object = Pyelonephritis_Infection, 
                             image = "slice9")
        ) 
#%>%
#  dplyr::select(!cell)
coords %>% head()


# create the spacexr data object
my_data <- 
  spacexr::SpatialRNA(coords = coords,
                      counts = GetAssayData(object = Pyelonephritis_Infection, 
                                            layer = "counts",
                                            assay = "Spatial"))
#my_data
table(spacexr_reference@cell_types)

# create the rctd object 
rctd_obj <- 
  spacexr::create.RCTD(spatialRNA = my_data, 
                       reference = spacexr_reference,
                       max_cores = 10,
                       CELL_MIN_INSTANCE = 5, # min number of cells per cell type lower if rare cell type
                       fc_cutoff = 0, # minimum log-fold-change (across cell types) for genes to be included in the platform effect normalization step (default = 0.5)
                       gene_cutoff = 0
                       #UMI_min = 10 # minimum UMI per pixel included in the analysis (default = 100)
                       ) 

# run RCTD
rctd_out <- 
  spacexr::run.RCTD(RCTD = rctd_obj, 
                    doublet_mode = "full") # default is "doublet" which fits at most two cell types per pixel, full is any number


# normalize the cell type proportions to sum to 1
norm_weights <- 
  spacexr::normalize_weights(weights = rctd_out@results$weights)

head(norm_weights)

# save the object of rctd
saveRDS(rctd_out, file = "rctd_out_UsingKidneyNoSortImmObj.rds")
# library(ggplot2)
# library(SpatialExperiment)
# library(SummarizedExperiment)
# #BiocManager::install("spacexr",force = TRUE)
# #options(timeout = 600000000) ### set this to avoid timeout error
# #devtools::install_github("dmcable/spacexr", build_vignettes = FALSE)
# library(spacexr)
# spacexr::plotAllWeights(
#     rctd_out, "weights_full", r = 0.05, lwd = 0, title = "Full Results"
# )
# add the deconvolution weights to the visium meta data 
Pyelonephritis_Infection <- 
  AddMetaData(object = Pyelonephritis_Infection, 
              metadata = norm_weights)



head(Pyelonephritis_Infection@meta.data)
Images(Pyelonephritis_Infection)
for (img in Images(Pyelonephritis_Infection)) {
  Pyelonephritis_Infection@images[[img]]@misc <- list()
}

saveRDS(Pyelonephritis_Infection, file = "Pyelonephritis_Infection_Decovoluted_v01262026.rds")
```
